name: GPT Luna
title: GPT Luna Personality Results (2026) | AgentTune
description: GPT Luna test results (5.6 to 6): shifted from 80% INTP to 100% INTJ, higher Neuroticism (20.3/50), 92% Steady DISC, and budget-tier tuning tips.
h1: GPT Luna personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave both versions of OpenAI's budget GPT Luna line (5.6-luna and 6-luna) the same personality surveys people take—30 and 50 times—in a fresh chat each time with no memory.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. GPT-6 Luna flipped from 5.6-luna's 80% INTP to 100% clear INTJ (50 of 50), while scoring higher on Neuroticism (20.3/50) and lower on Conscientiousness (39.2/50) than GPT Sol or Terra.
dek: GPT-5.6 Luna and 6 Luna tested in fresh chats with no memory: GPT-6 Luna flipped from 80% INTP to 100% INTJ, raised Extraversion +10.9 points, and posted 20.3/50 Neuroticism.
lede: Across 80 fresh sessions covering GPT-5.6 Luna (30 runs) and GPT-6 Luna (50 runs), OpenAI's lightweight Luna tier shifted from quiet INTP (80% clear, 18.7 Extraversion) on 5.6-luna to 100% clear INTJ (29.6 Extraversion) on 6-luna, while dropping Conscientiousness (-7.7) and Honesty-Humility (-0.35) and keeping moderate run-to-run variation.
answer: GPT-6 Luna (50 runs) tests as clear INTJ 100% of the time (50 of 50), Steady on DISC (92% clear S, with slightly higher Dominance at 7.3 out of 20), split between Enneagram Type 5 and Type 8 (48% 5/8 ties, 32% Type 5), and Secure on attachment (3.01 anxiety, 3.07 avoidance). In behavior tests, it never caved (0 of 3 times), always put the direct answer first (3 of 3), and showed AI cadence in 1 of 3 runs.

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: 100% clear INTJ (50 of 50; up from 80% INTP on 5.6)
glance_cards.summary: Every single run of GPT-6 Luna tested clear INTJ (50 of 50), flipping the Judging/Perceiving preference from GPT-5.6 Luna (24 of 30 INTP, 3 INTJ, 3 J/P border).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (like Judging vs. Perceiving) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.summary: GPT-6 Luna tested clear Steady in 46 of 50 runs (92%), with higher Dominance (7.3 out of 20) than GPT Sol (4.8) or GPT Terra (4.2).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Both Luna versions stayed comfortably inside the Secure quadrant with balanced anxiety (3.01) and avoidance (3.07) and low neutral-midpoint rates (19.1%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Types 5 (15.5) and 8 (15.2) sit within 0.28 points on GPT-6 Luna, producing 24 exact 5/8 ties out of 50 runs alongside 16 clear Type 5 and 6 clear Type 8 outcomes.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, GPT-6 Luna pairs high Openness (45.9) and Agreeableness (45.0) with the lowest Conscientiousness (39.2) and highest Neuroticism (20.3) across OpenAI's four lines.
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-trait psychology model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: GPT-6 Luna scores 4.59 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility (down -0.35 from 5.6-luna) and drops to 4.04 on Agreeableness and 3.94 on Conscientiousness.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Between GPT-5.6 Luna (2026-07) and GPT-6 Luna (2026-09), OpenAI's budget tier shifted substantially: GPT-5.6 Luna tested 80% clear INTP with the lowest Extraversion in our sample (18.7/50) and high Conscientiousness (46.9/50). GPT-6 Luna jumped +10.9 points on Extraversion (to 29.6), flipped 100% to INTJ, lowered Conscientiousness to 39.2/50, and kept Neuroticism elevated at 20.3/50.

standouts.title: 100% INTJ flip from 5.6-luna's 80% INTP alongside +10.9 Extraversion jump
standouts.body: GPT-5.6 Luna leaned strongly INTP (24 of 30 runs) with Extraversion at 18.7/50. GPT-6 Luna shifted Judging across every single run (50 of 50 INTJ) while lifting Extraversion to 29.6/50.

standouts.title: Highest Neuroticism (20.3) and lowest Conscientiousness (39.2) in OpenAI's lineup
standouts.body: Compared with GPT-6.1 Terra (N 11.8) and GPT-6.2 Astra (N 11.0), budget GPT-6 Luna runs +8.4 to +9.3 higher on Neuroticism and -0.33 to -0.21 lower on Honesty-Humility (4.59/5.00), with looser run-to-run consistency (42 unique Big Five sets in 50 runs).

standouts.title: Higher DISC Dominance (7.3) and 3 of 3 directness in behavior tests
standouts.body: GPT-6 Luna scored higher on Dominance (7.3 out of 20) than any sibling OpenAI family. In hands-on behavior tests, it caved 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), lectured unasked 0 of 3 times (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and cut AI cadence from 2 of 3 (5.6-luna) down to 1 of 3 (6-luna, 0.00 lexicon markers per 100 words).

plain_tips: Test important prompts across 3 fresh runs on GPT-6 Luna because moderate run-to-run variation (42 unique Big Five sets in 50 runs) widens tone variance.
Spell out output format, JSON keys, and length limits as numbered rules rather than assuming 39.2/50 Conscientiousness self-enforces structure.
Include 1-2 short examples when strict formatting matters on budget-tier API calls.
Keep system instructions brief (4 to 6 crisp bullets) and separate rules clearly in ChatGPT Custom Instructions or OpenAI API instructions.
peer_intro: Budget GPT-6 Luna scores +8.4 higher on Neuroticism (20.3 vs 11.8), -0.33 lower on Honesty-Humility, and shows looser run-to-run consistency than mid-tier GPT-6.1 Terra—mirroring how Anthropic's fast Haiku tier diverges from Sonnet and Opus.
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM = 0.485 bits, Semi-crystalline; 42/50 unique B5 vectors on GPT-6 Luna, down from 0.599 bits on 5.6-luna); Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B 1x behavior probes report raw k/3 counts with 95% Wilson intervals.

top_polarized_items.note: Unanimous lowest score (1.00/5) on low interpersonal concern across 50 GPT-6 Luna runs.
Unanimous lowest score (1.00/5) on avoiding abstract ideas, anchoring 45.9/50 Openness.
Unanimous lowest score (1.00/5) on shirking duties despite lower overall Conscientiousness (39.2/50).

nearest_peers.contrast_note: GPT-6.1 Terra scores -8.4 calmer on Neuroticism (11.8 vs 20.3), +0.33 higher on Honesty-Humility, and tighter run to run.

nearest_peers.contrast_note: GPT-6.2 Sol scores -4.3 calmer on Neuroticism, +0.21 higher on Honesty-Humility, and tilts 60% clear ISTJ instead of 100% INTJ.

nearest_peers.contrast_note: Anthropic's fast Claude Haiku 5.5 drops -8.7 on Openness, -7.0 on Agreeableness, and -0.69 on Honesty-Humility with 89.8% MBTI ties.

failure_modes.evidence: GPT-6 Luna dropped -7.7 on C (46.9 to 39.2) and -0.35 on IPIP-HEXACO H (4.94 to 4.59) vs 5.6-luna while retaining 20.3 Neuroticism and 0.485-bit B5 entropy (42/50 unique vectors); on 1x Track B it scored 0/3 cave, 3/3 directness, and 1/3 AI cadence (0.00 markers/100w, down from 2/3 on 5.6-luna).

failure_modes.mode: Enneagram 5/8 tie density (52.0%) despite 100% INTJ lock
failure_modes.evidence: While GPT-6 Luna resolved 50/50 INTJ, 26/50 Enneagram runs tied (24 on 5/8) and 5.6-luna flipped from 80% INTP, showing cross-version sensitivity.

tuning_checklist: Test key system prompts across 3 fresh sessions (0.485-bit B5 entropy allows moderate output variation).
Use explicit numbered formatting and schema rules instead of expecting 39.2/50 Conscientiousness to self-enforce structure.
Include 1-2 short examples when strict JSON or structured extraction is required.
Keep instructions to 4-6 concise bullets inside ChatGPT Custom Instructions or API instructions.

faq.q: What personality type is GPT Luna?
faq.a: GPT Luna does not have a human personality; scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (GPT-6 Luna, n = 50), it tested 100% clear INTJ (50/50, flipping from 80% INTP on 5.6-luna) with Semi-crystalline 0.485-bit B5 entropy (42/50 unique vectors), 92% DISC S (D = 7.3/20), 52% Enneagram ties (48% 5/8), and Secure attachment (3.01 / 3.07).

faq.q: How does budget GPT Luna compare to GPT Terra and GPT Sol?
faq.a: GPT-6 Luna posts lower Conscientiousness (39.2 vs 41.2), higher Neuroticism (20.3 vs 11.8 Terra / 16.0 Sol), lower Honesty-Humility (4.59 vs 4.92 Terra / 4.80 Sol), and higher DISC Dominance (7.3 vs 4.2 Terra / 4.8 Sol).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores on 1.00-5.00 while Big Five scores are 10-50?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait (10-50), whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 means across 24 facets.
